verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v2: zayyanta mazna ʿalā khayri l-bariyyati man qad ʾanzal llāhu fī ʾamdāḥihi s-suwarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v3: qad ṣughta fī sīrati l-mukhtāri shāfiʿinā mā yukhjilu l-jawhara l-yāqūta wad-durarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v4: wamā ʾatā khāliṣu l-ʾibrīzi majlisahu durrūlyatīmi ladā ʾarjāʾihi ʿtadharā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v5: kam jiʾita bidʿa watuʿyī fī madāʾiḥihi ʾahlu l-qarāʾiḥi kam ʾafḥamta min shuʿarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v6: raṣṣaʿta min baʿdimā washshaḥta madḥatahu nuḍāra maʿnā watazrī luʾuluʾā naẓarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v7: ʾaddayta farḍa madīḥi thumma nāfilahi waʾanta taqtabisu l-ʾanwāra wal-ʾatharā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v9: wal-ʿtimādu kathīru ʿaylama l-ʿulamā baḥra n-nadā ḥaythu jiʾita n-naẓma waṭ-ṭurarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v10: ʾinna l-mawāhiba taʾatī min mawāhibikum wash-sharḥu wal-ḥalabī t-tārīkhu qad ḥaḍarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v11: ʾinna sh-shafāʾa shifāʾu liṣ-ṣudūri falam tubqi l-ḥawāʾija fī yaʿqūba ḥaythu jarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v12: wasīratu bni hishāmi ghayru bāqiyati ʿaddu ʿtimādika fī l-ʾādābi win-nuẓarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v13: qad kunta mujtahidā fī l-ḥilli muʿtamidā ʿalā llisāni kadhā l-qāmūsu mā qtaṣarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v14: tāju l-ʿarūsi mina l-ʾīḍāḥ jiʾita bihi wanashshara ṭ-ṭayyā mimmā ḥayyara l-basharā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v16: hadhā kitābu nafisu qad jamaʿta lanā fīhi l-ʾaḥādītha wal-ʾāyāti was-siyarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v17: hadhā kitābu ʿajību jāmiʿu ḥikamā tazrī r-rayāḥīna win-nisrīna wal-ʿiṭarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v18: lam yabqa fīhi bimā yaʾatī n-nabīlu bihi min muqtaḍā l-ḥāli fī l-ʾamdāḥi ʾidh ẓaharā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v19: wan-naẓmu win-nathru mashhūrāni ʿindaka wal- ʾiflaḥu mā ʾaḥsana l-ʾasjāʿi wal-fiqarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v20: qad kunta takshifu ʿannā lubsa shāfiyanā walasta tatruku labsā qalla ʾaw kathurā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v21: ʾadnayta jumlaha ʾaghṣāni tuhhaṣiruhā mina l-madāʾiḥi yajnī kulluhā thamarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v22: kam dāra fikruka ʾāfāqa l-ʿulūmi wakam ʾakhrajta minhā mufīda qāḍīa ṭarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v23: wakullu fanni lisānu l-ḥāli qāla lakum ʾalqi l-ʿaṣā talqa min taysīri mā ʿasurā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v24: ʾamʿanta ʾatqanta ʾakmalta l-jamīʿa waqad ʾankaḥta min ʿamali ʿilmā kafā ntasharā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v25: wabaḥru ʿilmika yakfī n-nāsa sāḥiluhu siyyāni fīhi qarību bāʿidu shamurā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v26: waʿindaka l-ʿilmu wal-maʿnā tunashshiruhu bayna l-ʾaʾimmahi waṭ-ṭulabi wal-ʾumarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v27: ʾabradta kulla janāni daʾabuka l-jafalā walasta taʿlamu fī ʾiḥsānika n-naqarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v28: yā mādiḥa l-khayri wal-mukhtāri min muḍari juzīta khayra ʿamīmā shāmila wafarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v29: ʾaḥsanta madḥatahu wazurta rawḍatahu waṭufta bayta ʾilahī l-ḥijra wil-ḥajarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v30: waqumta fī ḥaqqihi lil-hi mujtahidā ʾafnayta minka bimarḍāti l-ʿalī l-ʿumarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v31: madaḥta man ṭībuhu ṭību l-ʾaṣūli waman ḍamma l-ʾilahu lahu ismā lis-sumā wasarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v32: madaḥta man qad ʾajāba llāhu daʿwatahu ʾiqlaʿu ghaythi mughiyithi sāla wānhamarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v33: madaḥta man ʿaẓẓama l-mawlā lahu khuluqa fī sūrati n-nūni baʿda l-ʾajri qad dhakarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v34: waʾanta taʿrifu mimmā qad yalīqu bihi mina l-madīḥi laqad ʾalzamtahu fikarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v35: fallāhu ʾakbaru jalla llāhu khāliqunā subḥāna man zayyana l-ʾakhlaqa was-siyarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v36: mā ʾaḥsana l-hadyā lil-hādī wahadyatihi ʾakrim biman khalaqa l-bārī lahu ṣ-ṣuwarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v37: hadhā kitābu l-ʾimāmi l-ḥibri mālikinā yā tuḥfaha l-māliki l-mawlā lladhī qtadarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v38: tanāfasū ʾayyuhā l-ʾikhwānu jāʾakumu mannā mina llāhi madḥu qad fashā khabarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v39: waḥaṣṣilūhu wala tanḥū ʾilā ḍajari qūmū ʾilayhi sirāʿā dūna man fatarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v40: waqābiluwuhu biḥusni ʾinna qābilahu yaḥwī l-masarrata wal-khayrāti wal-fakharā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v42: wakullu ṣaydi ladā jawfi l-farā mathalu faman yadullu ʿalā jawfi l-farā faqarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v43: fīhi l-manāfiʿu fī d-dunyā wāʾākhirati wakullu mā tashtahīhi l-ʾanfusu ḥtaḍarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v44: tanabbahū yā ʾunāsī wātrukū daʿaha tawajjahū wahwa yanfī ʿankumu ḍararā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v46: lil-hi lil-hi min madḥi barā kabidā fayā larāḥi yumīlu l-qalba wahwa ʿarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v47: fayā saʿādata man qad kāna lāzamahu mina llawāzmi fī ʾawqātihi naẓarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v48: yaʿʿumu nafʿa ʿalā l-ʾaḥbābi kullihimu wayastawī l-ʾaghniyā fī nafʿihi l-fuqarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v49: qūtu l-qulūbi lʾahli l-ʿishqi zāʾiduhum mawaddata khayru mamdūḥi qadi shtaharā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v50: ṭūbā limujtahidi lil-hi muqtaṣidi wamuhtadi muqtadi min ḥubbihi ʾatharā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v51: lahu banūdu mina r-raḍwāni nashsharahā rabbu l-baryyati fī l-buldāni lil-buṣarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v52: bihi qabūlu mina r-riḍwāni thumma riḍā ḥuḍūruhu ʿinda khayri l-khalqi qad ẓaharā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v53: mā lil-ḥijā ḥaṣru mā yaḥwīhi min ʿajabi falā warabbika la yaʾatiyihi man maharā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v55: l-ḥamdu lil-hi rabbi l-ʿālamīna ʿalā hadhī l-ʿaṭiyyati min shaykhi kafā wazarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v58: yā rabbi ṣalli ʿalā l-hādī waʿitratihi wāʾālihi ṣaḥbihi l-ʾaqmāri wal-ʾumarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v8: ʾabṣarta muḥkama ramyī s-sahmi yushhidu dhā kitābunā qurratu l-ʾabṣāri ʾidh ʿatharā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v15: waghayra dhalika mimmā qad dhakartu mina l-ʿiṭfayni min siyari wal-ḥalli dūna mirā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v45: qad qāla rabbī jalla llāhu fāstabiqū l-khayrāti bal sābiqū min baʿdi dhā ʾamarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v54: ʾinna l-mazābira la zālat tumārisuhu ṭūbā lidhī llajiddi ʾin ʾamsā ʾawi abtakarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v56: wabīlkhilaṣi wabīlmamdūḥi ʾaʿṭi lanā l-ʾikhlaṣa yā rabbi wat-tawfīqa wil-yusarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v57: ʾaʿnī bihi l-khayra khayra l-khalqi shāfiʿanā l-mukhtāra min nisbahi ʾawlaytahu muḍarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v1: yā man ʾatā bikhalāṣi fāʾiqi durerā qad jiʾta mā yuʿjibu s-sūdāna wal-ghurarā
verses.ya-man-ata-bikhilasin-c1-v41: fīhi l-ghanīmtu wan-nuʿmā liḥāʾizihi tallāhi yaʿrifu dhā ḥaqqā mani aʿtabarā
